title: Samsung, SK chiefs to meet Nvidia's Huang in New York amid US investment pressure
content: Samsung Electronics Chairman Jay Y. Lee and SK Group Chairman Tae-won Chey are traveling to New York at the end of September 2026 to meet Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang again as Washington presses South Korean companies to expand US investment. The planned trip is drawing market attention because Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are already pursuing large-scale spending in the US and could discuss further business ties on the sidelines of the event.
